author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More for When the Silent Bird Sings
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ↩️ We're looking for help with "When the Silent Bird Sings" and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we're open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: -Name, general location -Position applying for -Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples -Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) -Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) -Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work -Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) -Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) -Other notable experience / specializations *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️

author: emilygraceillustration
title: Storyboard Artist Wanted for Animatic
content: STORYBOARD ARTIST WANTED! 🎬 I'm looking for a talented freelance storyboard artist to collaborate on a short proof-of-concept animatic for an original animated action-adventure series. I'm particularly keen to hear from artists who specialise in dynamic action sequences, cinematic composition and strong character moments. This is a paid opportunity for a small, creator-led project. If you're interested, or know someone who might be a great fit, please get in touch or tag them below. Please share your portfolio/reel and rates via DM. Thanks!

author: aionlabo
title: Atomic Cartoons Seeks CG Storyboard Artist
content: Atomic Cartoons seeks a CG Storyboard Artist for an ongoing animated series. Applicants need 2+ years' relevant CG storyboarding experience, Storyboard Pro skills and current legal eligibility to work in Canada. Documented BC residency as of 31 December 2025 is required. Remote work is available within British Columbia; Vancouver and Lower Mainland artists may choose hybrid or studio work. CAD1,500–1,800 per week. No application deadline or contract duration stated.
